scripts.build: cd packages/tui && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && bun run check:pinned-deps && bun run check:ts-imports && bun run check:shrinkwrap && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:browser-smoke
scripts.start: bun run build && TAU_DEBUG_LOADER=1 TAU_DEBUG_TOOL_RESULT=1 bun packages/coding-agent/dist/cli.js --provider openrouter --model xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro
scripts.version:patch: bunx npm version patch -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install
scripts.version:minor: bunx npm version minor -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install
scripts.version:major: bunx npm version major -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check
